title: Art. 3.4 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, A. General, 3.4
content:
Contracting States shall not extend the validity of their machine readable travel documents.

Note. Specifications for machine readable travel documents (Doc 9303) do not permit alteration of the expiration date and other data in the machine readable zone.
